typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	BATCH_ID as integer (),
	FAC_COUNT as integer (),
	FILE_COUNT as integer (),
	gv_CountOracleTable as string (),
	gv_OraclePassword as string (),
	gv_OracleProvider as string (),
	gv_OracleUserID as string (),
	gv_OutputFolder as string (),
	gv_strOracleDS as string (),
	SQL_DEFAULT_GET_WARP_DATA as string (),
	SQL_GET_WARP_DATA as string (),
	SQL_PULLED_DATE_GET_WARP_DATA as string (),
	SQL_RUN_DATE_GET_WARP_DATA as string (),
	strDataSource as string (),
	strInitialCatalog as string (),
	strPassword as string (),
	strSqlServerProvider as string (),
	strUserName as string (),
	V_PULLED_DATE as timestamp (),
	V_RUN_DATE as timestamp (),
	V_SERVICE_DATE as string (),
	V_SNPSHT_DATE as string ()
}

source(output(
		GRGR_CK as string,
		GRGR_ID as string,
		CSCS_ID as string,
		CSPI_ID as string,
		PDPD_ID as string,
		COUNT as string,
		PULLED_DATE as timestamp,
		DATE_SENT_TO_WARP as timestamp,
		COUNT_ID as string,
		RUN_DATE as timestamp,
		SALES_COUNT as string,
		LAPSE_COUNT as string,
		ZIPCODE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select      COUNT_ID,     GRGR_CK,     GRGR_ID,     CSCS_ID,     CSPI_ID,     PDPD_ID,     "COUNT",     PULLED_DATE,     DATE_SENT_TO_WARP,     RUN_DATE FROM AGP.WARP_MEMBER_COUNTS WHERE DATE_SENT_TO_WARP IS NULL',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLESRCFACETSWARPMEMBERCOUNTS11
OLESRCFACETSWARPMEMBERCOUNTS11 derive(BATCH_ID = $BATCH_ID) ~> DERADDBATCHID11
DERADDBATCHID11 derive({Copy of CSPI_ID} = CSPI_ID,
		{Copy of COUNT_ID} = toString(COUNT_ID),
		{Copy of CSCS_ID} = CSCS_ID,
		{Copy of PDPD_ID} = PDPD_ID,
		{Copy of GRGR_ID} = GRGR_ID) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		CSCS_ID as string,
		RUN_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		GRGR_CK as integer,
		LAPSECOUNT as integer,
		BATCH_ID as integer,
		SALESCOUNT as integer,
		PDPD_ID as string,
		COUNT_ID as string,
		GRGR_ID as string,
		COUNT as integer,
		DATE_SENT_TO_WARP as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CSPI_ID as string,
		PULLED_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		CSCS_ID = {Copy of CSCS_ID},
		RUN_DATE,
		GRGR_CK,
		LAPSECOUNT = LAPSE_COUNT,
		BATCH_ID,
		SALESCOUNT = SALES_COUNT,
		PDPD_ID = {Copy of PDPD_ID},
		COUNT_ID = {Copy of COUNT_ID},
		GRGR_ID = {Copy of GRGR_ID},
		COUNT,
		DATE_SENT_TO_WARP,
		CSPI_ID = {Copy of CSPI_ID},
		PULLED_DATE)) ~> OLEDSTWARPLOADWARPMEMBERCOUNTS11
